background_story: Killer was a notorious gambler in the underground casinos of Macau. His real name was lost to the annals of time, but his reputation as a fantan master was legendary. Fantan, a game of chance and skill, was Killer's game of choice. He would often bet big, and his wins were as frequent as his losses were staggering. Killer's nickname was earned not just for his ruthless betting style, but also for his ability to 'kill' the game, consistently emerging victorious against all odds. His presence at the fantan table would draw in crowds, and his games were always the most anticipated and feared. Despite his tough exterior, Killer had a soft spot for those in need and was known to use his winnings to help those less fortunate.
